selection_rules.statement: A loadout is {primary, secondary, grenade, stratagems:[4 distinct ids]}; canonical form sorts stratagem ids only and keeps locked shows in display order.
Wiki category throwables selects into the grenade slot.
No legacy stats/bonus values and no per-category count scoring are part of this catalog.
M-104 Incinerator fast recon vehicle is kept in exclusions only, at explicit user request; it is never extractable.
Mission and civilian wiki pages are not equipment and never enter the catalog.
